rhs_residency.note: Full packs fitting resident RHS tensors once; stream reloads the active weight tile for each output tile. Oversized tensors always stream.

matmul_order.mechanism: WS weights reused across accumulator M panel
matmul_order.note: Output_tile retains the incumbent M/N/K tile order. M_panel retains up to1024 accumulator rows and reuses each K/N weight tile across M using COMPUTE_AND_STAY; pooling keeps its own schedule.

host_pointwise_fusion.mechanism: single-use f32 pointwise chain loop fusion
host_pointwise_fusion.note: Requires pure all-parallel generics, identity full output maps, same f32 result shape, unused destination args, identity internal edge maps; preserves scalar DAG order and source attribution.

lhs_residency.mechanism: retain a full K panel of LHS across N output tiles
lhs_residency.note: Retain full K activation panels across N; M-panel path bounds retained M rows by free scratch after live RHS and accumulator capacity. Pooling keeps its own schedule.

conv_preparation.mechanism: device gather, DRAM im2col, or scratchpad activation panel reuse
conv_preparation.note: Bounded device DRAM preparation, scratch activation reuse, or aligned-CI scratch preparation feeding the shared M-panel consumer. Source and storage legality independently select fallback. spad_m_runs additionally splits logical M tiles into maximal row/image/padding-bounded DMA runs sharing source address geometry across channels; optional explicit choice. Regional_runs selects spad_m_runs for alignedCI,M>16,N>16,MAC>=2^20,nonpool/nonpercolumn,oneKpanel fits liveSP; otherwise retain device_im2col_pool. Regional selected provisionally from matched complete-census fast estimates on four shapes and one original physical witness; wide error bands and missing incumbent complete timing remain visible.

graph_storage_reuse.mechanism: reuse compatible dead graph scratch buffers
graph_storage_reuse.note: Exact dtype/count/alignment slots; full source liveness including nested uses and delayed fused uses; excludes inputs/returns/alias views and tensor.empty; reuse after serialized completion boundary.

elementwise_order.mechanism: batch accumulator operand sums over independent local tiles
elementwise_order.note: For two-source sums initialize a bounded panel of distinct accumulator rows, fence before accumulating B, read out, and fence before panel reuse; tile remains incumbent.

entry_context.note: Optional FLUSH(0,0) immediately after opening fence, matching selected public resnet50 disassembly at PC0x8010b7ba; detailed TLB semantics remain unknown.

schedule_policy.mechanism: geometry and storage based matrix schedule selection
schedule_policy.note: Regional policy selects actual joint activation-panel/M-panel paths for large contractions, preserving small incumbents and explicit nonincumbent knob pairs; scratch/ACC legality remains independent.

movement_order.mechanism: batch graph movement DMA into disjoint local vectors
movement_order.note: Proof planner preserves exact movement and alias legality; panel loads distinct local slots, fences before stores and before slot reuse. i8 stays below resident RHS scratch rows; i32 bounded by accumulator capacity.

elementwise_policy.mechanism: geometry selects real accumulator-panel sum schedule
elementwise_policy.note: Two-source sums spanning at least two logical tiles select bounded accumulator panel; one-source and one-tile work remain tile, output/broadcast-bias alias stays incumbent; explicit acc_panel wins.

qk_preparation.mechanism: prepare K transpose with device DMA before shared matmul
qk_preparation.note: True source QK only; unique K batch/head preparation <=64MiB shared across grouped query heads; independent axes/scales preserved; pretransposed source MATMUL unchanged.

sibling_order.mechanism: pack independent one-row contractions sharing exact RHS into a matrix
sibling_order.note: Typed zero-init i8 MACs with raw i32 results, exact SSA RHS, no crossed use/effect; pack uses M1, pack_rows extends to M<=16; all rows DMA packed/scattered, all results retained, private storage bounded.

thin_matmul_order.mechanism: K-major streamed RHS with bounded independent N accumulators
thin_matmul_order.note: N-panel admission independently checks integer semantics, scalar readout, M<=16, strides and live storage. Regional cost rule requires positive K,N>16,MAC>=2^20: rawi32 admits N<=4096, or K>=2048 and N<=32768; scalar i8 admits M16,N<=16384. K>=2048,N>=1024 selects bounded64column RHS panels plus fullK A retention when SP fits. Other regional rawN>1024 may retain A without wide RHS. Smaller and other-scaled calls retain incumbents. Compact options pack accumulator rows by M; cached options retain A; wide options prepare actual disjoint scratch panels consumed by PRELOAD. Thresholds are conservative heuristics with limited boundary timing support, not learned optima. Additional independently validated scalar-i8 M1 region: K>=2048,2048<=N<=16384,MAC>=2^20 selects same actual wide RHS plus legal A retention. M2..15 scaled remain incumbent. Native below/at/above cutoff checks establish legality, not cost-optimal thresholds.

column_readout.mechanism: device raw matrix contraction followed by independent column scaled DMA readout
column_readout.note: Grouped contracts each equal-gain column group directly. Staged computes the raw i32 matrix once, then gathers its columns through accumulator DMA and exact f32 CONFIG_ST; private raw storage is bounded to64MiB. Both preserve all source columns, bias and activation order. Loop choices compact only adjacent full16-column tiles with bit-identical relative gain groups, preserving actual device command order and payload semantics. Regional selects staged_loops for K>=16 and more gain groups than physical N tiles, within64MiB raw storage; other geometry retains grouped. Supported by one large fully priced fast comparison and small physical witnesses; no large heldout timing or optimal-cutoff claim. Staged_panel batches independent raw M tiles into at most1024 disjoint ACC rows with one completion fence per panel; real optional lifetime/overlap alternative, defaults unchanged. Within staged regional geometry, M>16 uses accumulator panel provisionally from matched fast estimate3790794->3773416 (wide error bands, complete timing UNKNOWN); M<=16 retains the five physically checked staged_loops programs.

control_unroll.mechanism: bounded upstream unrolling of innermost runtime device command loops
control_unroll.note: Actual upstream count metadata consumed by LLVM O2. Body<=256 operations, trip>=factor and shared predicted extra-operation budget4096; literal resident bounded-unroll paths preserved. Optional, incumbent default; command order and changing-input native numerics checked.
